newsitem.title: CHINA: SHENZHEN FIYTA H1 NET UP ON SALES NETWORK.
newsitem.headline: SHENZHEN FIYTA H1 NET UP ON SALES NETWORK.

text.p: China's watch maker Shenzhen Fiyta Holdings Ltd boosted its first-half earnings by expanding its sales network, a company official said on Tuesday.

The company has set up stores in Shenzhen, Shanghai and other major cities in the first six months to try to boost sales and has plans to expand further, the official told the Hong Kong-based newsletter China Securities Bulletin.
Fiyta has faced a tough market in recent years due to depressed demand for luxury watches and from foreign competition, he said.
The company sold more expensive watches with higher profit margins in the first six months of 1997 compared with the year-ago period, he said. But he gave no figures.
The company has also expanded into the catering industry in a bid to diversify, he said.
Fiyta Holdings on Tuesday posted an 85-percent year-on-year surge in first half net profits to 48.55 million yuan under Chinese accounting standards.
Based on international standards, it booked net profits of 45.79 million yuan in the period but gave no comparative figures.
"Usually, sales in the second half are stronger than in the first half," the official said without giving details.
By the end of June, the company had 138.5 million outstanding shares, including 33.4 million A shares and 32.4 million B shares.
The company's per-share net reached 0.351 yuan in the first half compared with 0.189 yuan in the year-ago period based on Chinese standards.
Net assets per share were 2.869 yuan compared with 2.352 yuan in the first half of 1996.
